object: FIELD machine entrypoint / human-agent and agent-agent bounded handoff

source.user_intent: Reduce the gap between crew mates while converging on systems that work with human compliance; leave useful hooks for other workers without creating parallel control architecture.

before: FIELD already had one contributor submission envelope and one bounded SOURCE→HOLD→TURN→TRACE→RETURN protocol, but switching humans/agents still required manually reconstructing the execution context. The primary machine entrypoint could emit current/crystal/egress/contribution projections but could not normalize one submission into a portable bounded work object.
delta: Add /lib/field-crew-handoff.mjs as a pure stateless compiler; no network, queue, memory or effect path.
Add --handoff <submission.json> to the existing scripts/emit-agent-transcript.mjs machine entrypoint; text and --json projections carry the same work object.
Emit deterministic opaque crew:<fnv64> context handles from source_ref + intent + object_ref + contribution/evidence class + delta/question, deliberately excluding worker labels and move selection.
Carry 0–3 explicit native move declarations, optional selected_move_id, evidence pointers and exact RETURN; >3 moves and selected TURN on unresolved objects fail closed.
Expose SOURCE_REQUIRED / HOLD_REQUIRED / HOLD_READY / TURN_READY as coordination states only; none grant NOW, priority, effect, routing or merge authority.
Extend SUBMISSION_CONTRACT to v0.2 with optional contributor/receiver hints and bounded execution fields; labels remain informational.
Extend the existing field-machine-reducer selftest so older transcript/crystal/reduce/converge modes and the new handoff mode share one regression gate.
Expose the new mode through /llms.txt rather than creating a /crew/ route, dashboard or second machine entrypoint.

external_correspondence.purpose: Borrow proven interoperability separations without importing another runtime or claiming protocol conformance.

a2a.borrowed_shape: separate task/context correlation, status and artifacts/evidence so independent opaque agents can cooperate without sharing internals

mcp.borrowed_shape: stateless/sessionless capability exchange with explicit handles rather than hidden shared session state

external_correspondence.boundary: FIELD crew handoff is a local transient projection only; it is neither an A2A server/task implementation nor an MCP transport/server.

laws: HANDOFF HANDLE CORRELATES CONTEXT; IT DOES NOT CREATE A TASK DATABASE.
HANDOFF PRESERVES INTENT + ADDRESS + BOUNDED MOVES + EVIDENCE + RETURN; IT DOES NOT SERIALIZE HIDDEN CHAIN OF THOUGHT.
ZERO MOVES MEANS HOLD_REQUIRED; MORE THAN THREE FAILS CLOSED.
SELECTED TURN != EFFECT AUTHORITY; HOST-NATIVE RELEASE/COMMIT REMAINS EXPLICIT.

verification.local_static: Implemented selftest coverage in tools/field-machine-reducer-selftest.mjs; exact branch CI still required.
falsifiers: same normalized work object produces nondeterministic context handles
changing contributor_ref or receiver_hint changes the context handle
compiler accepts more than three moves
unresolved object can carry selected TURN

residue: No persistent shared task store is introduced. Long-running asynchronous coordination should remain native to the executor/host until a real missing function is demonstrated.
No automatic agent routing is introduced. receiver_hint is informational only; capability discovery can be added later if a concrete multi-worker miss demonstrates value.
No hidden reasoning transfer is attempted. Workers receive explicit source/intent/move/evidence/return state and must recover any necessary source depth themselves.
next: After exact-head green, use the handoff on a real cross-worker repo change. Promote further routing/capability discovery only if that run exposes a concrete information loss or coordination failure.
stop: Do not add a crew dashboard, shared memory service, agent registry, auto-router or task database merely because the handoff format exists.
